machine_end_gcode:
PRINT_END ; start.cfg
SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=was_interrupted VALUE=False ; clear Sovol PLR state
RUN_SHELL_COMMAND CMD=clear_plr
clear_last_file
machine_start_gcode:
SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=was_interrupted VALUE=True ; Sovol power-loss recovery flag
G28 ; home all
Z_TILT_ADJUST ; level dual Z (shared start.cfg does not)
G28 Z ; re-home Z after tilt — PRINT_START's _CHOME then skips homing
PRINT_START EXTRUDER_TEMP=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] BED_TEMP=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; start.cfg: heat, KAMP mesh, Smart_Park, LINE_PURGE
name: Sovol SV07 Plus 0.4 nozzle Optimized
printer_notes: Uses printfarm shared start.cfg + macros.cfg + KAMP on the printer. Z_TILT and Sovol PLR handled in start/end gcode.
